summary: iQSTEL Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release dated September 3, 2026, concerning a strategic partnership with microdrama entertainment service IDILIO TV. The company announced corporate objectives: mobile-operator distribution reaching approximately 40 million potential users by end of Q2 2027 and 500,000 gross subscribers by year-end 2027, leveraging its existing relationships with over 600 telecom operators across 24 countries. IDILIO TV is backed by a $5 million seed round led by a16z Speedrun with Goodwater Capital, WndrCo and David Velez participating. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle are presented.
